description: This file declares the module 'node:module' providing type definitions for Node.js module system functionalities, including class, functions, interfaces, and constants related to module resolution, cache management, source maps, and hooks.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a Node.js module, including its constructor and properties such as filename, id, exports, require, etc.

classes.name: SourceMap
classes.description: Represents a source map for debugging, including methods to find entry points and original sources.

methods.name: enableCompileCache
methods.description: Enables the module compile cache in Node.js with optional configurations.

methods.name: flushCompileCache
methods.description: Flushes the current module compile cache to disk.

methods.name: getCompileCacheDir
methods.description: Returns the directory used for the module compile cache if enabled.

methods.name: findPackageJSON
methods.description: Finds the nearest package.json for a module specifier relative to a base URL or path.

methods.name: isBuiltin
methods.description: Checks if a module name is a built-in Node.js module.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers hooks to customize module resolution and loading behavior.

methods.name: registerHooks
methods.description: Registers module resolution and load hooks with specified options.

methods.name: stripTypeScriptTypes
methods.description: Removes or transforms TypeScript types in code snippets.

methods.name: syncBuiltinESMExports
methods.description: Synchronizes live bindings between CommonJS and ES Module exports for built-in modules.

methods.name: getSourceMapsSupport
methods.description: Checks if source map support for stack traces is enabled.

methods.name: findSourceMap
methods.description: Fetches the source map for a given file path.

methods.name: setSourceMapsSupport
methods.description: Enables or disables source map support with options.
